chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey - Ch 198: Muddy Blades and Bitter Alliances
chapter_meta_description: Han Li uses a clever blade trap to kill an armored centipede, then watches three cultivators battle over ripe spirit herbs in a classic two-against-one power play.

og_description: Han Li’s preparation pays off, but in a nearby valley, the real politics of cultivation flare up—two experts ally and chase off a lone youth.
